caption: 5 iron-rich meals for babies 🤍 After 6 months, iron becomes essential — and these are some of the best sources you can offer: • Beef • Chicken liver • Red lentils These meals are simple, nutrient-dense, and easy to include in your baby’s routine. Tip: pair iron-rich foods with vitamin C to help absorption. — If you want iron-rich recipes like these, I created a free 5-recipe cookbook 🤍 👉 You can find it in my bio #babyfood #babyledweaning #ironrichfoods #startingsolids #toddlermealideas
